title: SquareType Capitalized
description: Squared vanilla font you deserve. Now it's also CAPITALIZED!
body:
**Have you heard of SquareType?**\
**Have you ever wanted it to be a little bit more spicy?**\
**_Well, now you can!_**
# INTRODUCING
![SquareType Capitalized Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8da507b47c851a9012af74c98f69ca8fb6abc44a.png)

With this resourcepack all of your letters will look like they are written in capital letters. Lowercase letters will look like mini versions of their Uppercase letters.
Here are some pictures of how this fonts looks like in comparison with boring vanilla font.
![English Symbols Comparison](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ba688bbcf1608646792c543e8a24795139d9302.png)
And yes, as usual, this font also supports Russian.
